episodes.title: Storm Clouds Gather
episodes.summary: Pressured by his father and mocked by his peers, 15-year-old Tiuri competes to become a Knight of Dagonaut — just as the kingdom faces a dark threat.

episodes.title: Isn't She a Sweetheart?
episodes.summary: With the Red Riders and Novices hot on his trail, Tiuri makes his way to Mistrinaut, where the mayor's daughter takes a keen interest in his mission.

episodes.title: At the End of the World
episodes.summary: The Red Riders drive their captives high into the snowy mountains. Caught in a storm, Tiuri and Lavinia take shelter inside an ominous monastery.

episodes.title: Danger Knights
episodes.summary: On a ship headed toward Unauwen, Tiuri and Lavinia meet a mysterious passenger who seems to know the secret of Tiuri's past — and his destiny.

episodes.title: Spiral
episodes.summary: Ardanwen guides the group to an eerily empty town. Lavinia helps Tiuri practice controlling his powers. A startling discovery divides the Novices.

episodes.title: When the Blood Moon Rises
episodes.summary: As the Blood Moon nears and Viridian prepares for his homecoming, Tiuri and friends wrestle with doubt, betrayal and a daunting final test.
